words.engDef: relating to the design of buildings
words.example: The building's architectural design incorporates modern and traditional elements.
words.chinese: 與建築設計或風格相關的；建築學的

words.engDef: a curved structure forming a passage or entrance
words.example: The new office building features a grand archway leading to the reception area.
words.chinese: 拱門；拱道，通常指建築物或景觀中的拱形入口。

words.engDef: a comfortable chair with supports for the arms
words.example: The waiting area is furnished with comfortable armchairs to accommodate clients.
words.chinese: 扶手椅；配有扶手的椅子，通常用於休息或閱讀。

words.engDef: a large open space in the centre of a building
words.example: The hotel's atrium featured a stunning waterfall and lush greenery.
words.chinese: 建築物的中庭，通常是入口大廳或寬敞的公共空間。
words.rootPrefix: atrium (the central hall of a Roman house)

words.engDef: a sheet of canvas stretched out to give shade
words.example: The restaurant installed a new awning to provide shade for outdoor diners.
words.chinese: 遮陽篷；簷篷，通常用於商店或建築物外，以遮擋陽光或雨水。

words.engDef: large farm buildings used for storing crops or animals
words.example: The company is considering purchasing several barns to convert into office spaces.
words.chinese: 穀倉；牲畜棚舍

words.engDef: to be set out on the paved area outside
words.example: The outdoor furniture will be arranged on the patio for the company picnic.
words.chinese: 被安排在露台

words.engDef: to have something along the edges or inside
words.example: The conference room is lined with soundproofing panels to minimize noise.
words.chinese: 覆蓋著；排列著（某物），通常指內襯或邊緣。

words.engDef: to be sheltered from direct sunlight
words.example: The building's south-facing windows are be shaded by the trees to reduce heat gain.
words.chinese: 被遮蔽；位於陰影中

words.engDef: a frame in which bicycles can be parked
words.example: The office building provides a secure bicycle rack for employees who commute by bike.
words.chinese: 自行車架；自行車停放架

words.engDef: a person or company that constructs buildings
words.example: The construction company is a leading builder of commercial properties.
words.chinese: 建築商；建造者；營造商

words.engDef: a plant smaller than a tree with many branches
words.example: The landscaping team is responsible for trimming the bushes around the office building.
words.chinese: 灌木叢，矮灌木

words.engDef: an underground room used for storage
words.example: The warehouse manager instructed the team to move the excess inventory to the cellar for safekeeping.
words.chinese: 地窖；地下室（通常用於儲存物品，尤其是在商業或工業環境中）

words.engDef: a flat that is owned rather than rented
words.example: They decided to buy a condominium instead of a house because it required less maintenance.
words.chinese: 公寓大廈；分層產權式公寓（屋主擁有自己的單位，並與其他屋主共同擁有公共區域）

words.engDef: pieces of cloth hung at a window
words.example: The hotel room features blackout curtains to ensure a restful night's sleep for guests.
words.chinese: 窗簾；帷幕

words.engDef: the eastern part of a town or city
words.example: The company is considering relocating its warehouse to the eastside to reduce transportation costs.
words.chinese: 東側區域；位於東方的區域（通常指城市或城鎮的一部分）

words.engDef: forced someone to leave a property by law
words.example: The landlord evicted the tenant for failing to pay rent for three months.
words.chinese: 將...強行驅逐（出房屋、公寓等）；逐出
words.rootPrefix: e- (out) + vict (to conquer, from vincere) -> to drive out by law

words.engDef: the buildings and equipment provided for a purpose
words.example: The new office facilities include a conference room, high-speed internet, and a cafeteria.
words.chinese: 設施；指公司或場所提供的建築、設備、服務等，以支援業務運作的便利設施。

words.engDef: a piece of equipment fixed permanently in a building
words.example: The new office building is equipped with modern fixtures, including energy-efficient lighting and plumbing.
words.chinese: 固定裝置；（建築物或車輛中的）固定設備

words.engDef: a drawing showing the layout of rooms on one level
words.example: Before signing the lease, carefully review the floor plan to ensure it meets your company's needs.
words.chinese: 建築平面圖；樓層平面圖，通常用於展示建築物或空間的佈局。

words.engDef: the material used to cover a floor
words.example: The new flooring in the office lobby creates a more welcoming atmosphere.
words.chinese: 地板覆面；地板材料

words.engDef: an area of soil where flowers are grown
words.example: The hotel's landscaping includes several beautifully maintained flower beds.
words.chinese: 花壇；種植花卉的區域，通常用於美化環境。

words.engDef: available to be rented for a period
words.example: The office space is currently for lease and includes all necessary utilities.
words.chinese: 可租賃的；可供出租的

words.engDef: spaces where you may park without paying
words.example: The hotel offers free parking for all guests.
words.chinese: 免費停車位；不需付費的停車服務

words.engDef: the main entrance door of a building
words.example: The delivery driver left the package by the front door.
words.chinese: 正門；主要入口

words.engDef: areas of ground where flowers and plants are grown
words.example: The hotel boasts beautifully landscaped gardens, providing a tranquil escape for guests.
words.chinese: 花園；庭園（通常指經過規劃和維護的區域，用於種植植物或休閒娛樂）

words.engDef: a small group of trees
words.example: The resort is situated in a beautiful grove of olive trees.
words.chinese: 一排排樹木聚集的地方；小樹林

words.engDef: a rail fixed to a wall or post to hold onto
words.example: The hotel is installing new handrails along the staircase to improve safety for guests.
words.chinese: 扶手，欄杆（通常用於樓梯、走廊等，提供安全支撐）

words.engDef: a person who owns the house they live in
words.example: The homeowner's association is responsible for maintaining the common areas of the community.
words.chinese: 房地產所有者；自住戶

words.engDef: the places where people live
words.example: The marketing team surveyed 500 homes to assess the demand for smart thermostats.
words.chinese: 住宅；居所，指供人居住的房屋或公寓，常用於描述公司提供的員工住宅或房地產產品。

words.engDef: buildings made for people to live in
words.example: The real estate company specializes in selling houses in the suburbs.
words.chinese: 住宅；房屋（通常指多戶住宅或多棟住宅）

words.engDef: an area where many houses are built together
words.example: The company is investing heavily in a new housing development to meet the growing demand.
words.chinese: 住宅開發案；大型住宅社區

words.engDef: a small shelter for a dog; also a boarding place for dogs
words.example: The hotel offers a luxurious kennel service for guests' pets.
words.chinese: 狗舍；犬舍（通常指商業性或專業的犬舍）

words.engDef: the land at the edge of a lake
words.example: The hotel's lakefront location offers stunning views.
words.chinese: 湖濱；湖畔的（位置或區域）

words.engDef: the designing and planting of gardens and grounds
words.example: The company is investing in landscaping to improve the building's curb appeal.
words.chinese: 景觀美化；庭園設計與維護

words.engDef: a narrow flat surface sticking out from a wall or cliff
words.example: The construction team installed a small ledge for the security cameras to monitor the building's entrance.
words.chinese: 突出物；平台（通常指懸崖、牆壁或架子的突出部分，可供放置物品或站立）

words.engDef: the person who rents property from an owner
words.example: The lessee is responsible for paying the monthly rent on time.
words.chinese: 承租人
words.rootPrefix: lease + -ee (the one it is done to)

words.engDef: the owner who rents property to someone else
words.example: The lessor is responsible for maintaining the structural integrity of the building.
words.chinese: 出租人；貸方；租賃方

words.engDef: placed or situated in a particular position
words.example: The company's headquarters are located in the central business district.
words.chinese: 位於；處於（某個位置），通常指具體地點或區域。

words.engDef: a machine used to cut grass
words.example: My old lawn mower broke down, so I need to buy a new one.
words.chinese: 割草機

words.engDef: having several floors
words.example: The company is planning to build a new multistory office building downtown.
words.chinese: 多層建築的；有多層樓的
words.rootPrefix: multi- (many) + historia (an inquiry, a tale, Greek)

words.engDef: large paintings done on walls
words.example: The hotel is commissioning vibrant murals to enhance the lobby's aesthetic appeal.
words.chinese: 壁畫；大型壁面裝飾畫，通常用於裝飾建築物或公共空間。

words.engDef: a tall structure built to give a wide view
words.example: The city planning department uses the observation tower to monitor traffic flow and identify potential bottlenecks.
words.chinese: 觀景塔；用於觀察或監控的塔狀建築，通常用於城市規劃、交通管理或觀光。

words.engDef: a person living or working in a place
words.example: The previous occupant left some furniture behind.
words.chinese: 佔用者；居住者；（交通工具的）乘客

words.engDef: the outside wall of a building
words.example: The building's outdoor walls need to be repainted to improve its curb appeal.
words.chinese: 室外牆面；建築物外牆

words.engDef: public areas of grass and trees for recreation
words.example: The company is considering purchasing land to develop new parks for employees and their families.
words.chinese: 公園；綠地

words.engDef: a long flat piece of wood
words.example: The carpenter used a long plank to create a sturdy shelf.
words.chinese: 厚木板，板條；(政黨等的)政綱條款，政策要點；(動詞) 鋪設木板；做平板支撐 (運動)。

words.engDef: an open public square in a town
words.example: The new office building features a spacious plaza for employees to relax during breaks.
words.chinese: 廣場；公共廣場，通常位於商業或辦公區域，提供休憩或活動空間。
words.rootPrefix: platea (a broad street, from Greek platys broad)

words.engDef: grown in a pot rather than in the ground
words.example: The office lobby was decorated with several potted plants to create a welcoming atmosphere.
words.chinese: 盆栽的；種植於盆中的

words.engDef: a house used as a home rather than for business
words.example: The company policy prohibits soliciting business within a private residence.
words.chinese: 私人住宅，指非商業用途的住所。

words.engDef: buildings and land owned by someone; also qualities
words.example: The company is evaluating the properties to determine their market value.
words.chinese: 特性、財產、屬性（尤指房地產或公司資產）

words.engDef: the boundary that marks the edge of a piece of land
words.example: The surveyor confirmed that the new fence was built exactly on the property line.
words.chinese: 土地界線；產權邊界

words.engDef: an open area of grass and trees for everyone to use
words.example: The company is considering building a new office complex near a public park to attract employees.
words.chinese: 公共公園，通常為政府或社區維護的開放空間，供公眾休憩娛樂。

words.engDef: to state the price you are willing to pay
words.example: We're waiting to see if anyone puts in an offer on the property.
words.chinese: 提出報價；提交出價（通常指在競標、購買房產等情況下）

words.engDef: the selling of land or buildings
words.example: The company reported a significant increase in real estate sales during the last quarter.
words.chinese: 不動產銷售；房地產交易

words.engDef: a person whose job is to sell houses and land
words.example: The realtor helped us find a suitable office space in the city center.
words.chinese: 房地產經紀人；房地產中介

words.engDef: an agent or firm that sells houses and land
words.example: Our realtor helped us find the perfect office space in a convenient location.
words.chinese: 房地產經紀人（通常指隸屬於房地產仲介公司的專業人士，協助客戶買賣或租賃房產）

words.engDef: land and buildings considered as property
words.example: The company's portfolio consists primarily of commercial realties.
words.chinese: 實業、實體資產（通常指不動產）。

words.engDef: to paint or paper a room again
words.example: We plan to redecorate the living room next month to give it a fresh look.
words.chinese: 重新裝修；重新佈置；重新裝潢
words.rootPrefix: re- (again, back) + decus (an ornament, from decere to be fitting) + -ate

words.engDef: the changing of the structure or look of a building
words.example: The company is planning to remodel the office space to improve employee productivity.
words.chinese: 翻新；改建；重新裝修（通常指商業或住宅空間）
words.rootPrefix: re- (again, back) + modulus (a small measure, from modus a measure)

words.engDef: repairs and improvements made to a building
words.example: The company is planning extensive renovations to the office building to improve employee productivity.
words.chinese: 裝修；整修（通常指對建築物或空間進行的改善或更新）

words.engDef: to let someone use your property for payment
words.example: The company decided to rent out the unused office space to reduce operating costs.
words.chinese: 將房產或設備出租給他人以獲取租金。

words.engDef: the contract setting out the terms of a tenancy
words.example: Please review the rental agreement carefully before signing it.
words.chinese: 租賃合約；租約，規範租賃關係的法律文件。

words.engDef: the properties or items that are hired out
words.example: The company is considering expanding its business by offering equipment rentals.
words.chinese: 租賃；租用（物品或服務）

words.engDef: a person who pays to use a property
words.example: The landlord is offering incentives to attract new renters.
words.chinese: 租戶；承租者（指租賃房屋或辦公室的人）

words.engDef: the people who live in a place
words.example: The apartment complex offers a range of amenities for its residents.
words.chinese: 居民；住戶（通常指在特定區域或建築物居住的人）

words.engDef: the raised ground at the edge of a river
words.example: The new resort is being built along the riverbank, offering stunning views.
words.chinese: 河岸；河邊

words.engDef: the area of land beside a river
words.example: The hotel's location on the riverside offers stunning views of the city.
words.chinese: 河岸；河邊

words.engDef: the top outer surface of a building
words.example: The maintenance team needs to inspect the rooftop for any leaks before the rainy season.
words.chinese: 屋頂；建築物頂層

words.engDef: an underground pipe that carries away waste water
words.example: The city council approved a project to upgrade the old sewer system.
words.chinese: 下水道；污水管

words.engDef: placed in a particular position
words.example: The company's headquarters are situated in the heart of the city's financial district.
words.chinese: 位於；處於（某個位置），通常指地理位置或狀態。

words.engDef: a very tall building in a city
words.example: The company's headquarters is located in a modern skyscraper in the city's financial district.
words.chinese: 摩天大樓；極高層建築

words.engDef: a thick flat piece of stone, concrete, or wood
words.example: The workers laid the concrete slabs for the new patio.
words.chinese: 厚板；平板；厚片；石板

words.engDef: a surface with one end higher than the other
words.example: The new office building has a gentle slope to accommodate wheelchair access.
words.chinese: 斜坡；傾斜度，通常指地形或數據的傾斜程度。

words.engDef: an extra key kept in case the first is lost
words.example: The landlord provided a spare key in case of emergencies.
words.chinese: 備用鑰匙；備份鑰匙

words.engDef: a set of stairs with its supporting structure
words.example: Please be careful when using the staircase, especially when carrying heavy boxes.
words.chinese: 樓梯；梯子（通常指建築物內的樓梯）

words.engDef: steps that lead from one level of a building to another
words.example: Please be careful when using the stairs, especially when carrying heavy boxes.
words.chinese: 樓梯；階梯

words.engDef: a set of steps leading from one level to another
words.example: The fire marshal inspected the building's stairways to ensure they met safety regulations.
words.chinese: 樓梯；階梯

words.engDef: a residential area on the edge of a city
words.example: Many employees choose to live in the suburbs for a quieter lifestyle and larger homes.
words.chinese: 郊區；郊外地區（通常指城市周圍的住宅區，居民主要以通勤上班為主）

words.engDef: people who rent a property from an owner
words.example: The landlord is responsible for maintaining the property for his tenants.
words.chinese: 租戶；承租人（指承租房屋或辦公室的對象）

words.engDef: the physical features of an area of land
words.example: The construction company conducted a thorough survey of the terrain before starting the project.
words.chinese: 地形；地勢

words.engDef: a house in a row that shares walls with its neighbours
words.example: The company is considering purchasing a block of townhouses to accommodate its expanding workforce.
words.chinese: 排屋；連棟住宅，通常指兩層或以上的獨立住宅，與鄰居共用一側牆壁。

words.engDef: with nobody living there
words.example: The company is considering purchasing the uninhabited island for a resort development.
words.chinese: 未被居住的；荒無人煙的

words.engDef: a large container, especially one holding ashes or serving drinks
words.example: The estate agent confirmed that the property included a family urn containing the ashes of the previous owner.
words.chinese: 骨灰罈；存放骨灰的容器

words.engDef: a piece of land with no building on it
words.example: The company is looking for a vacant site to build a new office building.
words.chinese: 空置地塊；未被使用的土地

words.engDef: a covered platform along the outside of a house
words.example: The hotel guests enjoyed the sunset from the spacious veranda.
words.chinese: （建築物外面的）遮蓋的陽台或露台，通常用於休閒或社交。

words.engDef: a path built for people to walk along
words.example: The new office building features a covered walkway connecting the parking garage to the main entrance.
words.chinese: 人行道；行人專用通道

words.engDef: surrounded by a wall
words.example: The ancient city was a walled fortress, providing excellent protection against invaders.
words.chinese: 被城牆包圍的；有城牆的

words.engDef: decorated paper used to cover the walls of a room
words.example: The interior designer suggested a textured wallpaper to add warmth to the office lobby.
words.chinese: 壁紙；牆面裝飾紙

words.engDef: the shelf at the bottom of a window
words.example: The maintenance team needs to repair the cracked windowsill in the conference room.
words.chinese: 窗台；窗戶下方的水平平台
